text: A girl named June found a blue feather and put it in a book so she would not lose it.
The horse drank from the stream and then walked back to the barn with the farmer.
He tried to stack the cups, but they fell. He tried again, slower, and they stayed up.
The baby laughed when the dog licked her hand. Mom said the dog was being gentle.
Clouds hid the sun and the path got dark. They turned on a lamp and kept walking.
Pia drew a house with a red roof. Her brother added a tree and a yellow bird.
The ice melted in the glass. Water ran down the side and made a ring on the table.
A squirrel hid a nut under a leaf. In winter it came back and dug until it found it.
They waited for the bus in the rain. When it came, they shook their coats and sat down.
The old clock ticked in the hall. Nobody was awake except the cat on the stairs.
Leo learned to tie his shoes. He was proud, and he tied them again to show his dad.
The soup was too hot, so they blew on it. After a minute they could eat it.
A whale rose from the water and then slipped under again. The boat rocked a little.
She lost a tooth and put it under her pillow. In the morning a coin was there.
The kids built a fort from chairs and a blanket. They whispered so the walls would not fall.
Wind blew the leaves into a pile. Then it blew them apart, and they had to rake again.
The teacher read a story. When it ended, the class asked her to read one more page.
A candle burned on the table until the wax made a small white lake around it.
They planted a tree by the fence. Years later it made shade for the whole yard.
The fox stopped at the edge of the field. It listened, then ran into the dark trees.
